info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Banking Platform Operations Status API
info.description: The Banking Platform Operations Status API provides real-time insights into the operational status of banking IT management systems. This endpoint allows users to query the current status of various platform operations, helping organizations maintain optimal performance and quickly identify issues. Typical consumers include IT teams and system administrators who require up-to-date operational data for monitoring and reporting purposes. This API is essential for ensuring uninterrupted banking services and enhancing overall system reliability.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of platform operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current operational status of the IT management platform, providing insights into its performance and availability.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of platform operations in IT management. This body must be constructed in accordance with the specified JSON schema to ensure proper formatting and data consistency.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current status of platform operations.

GetPlatformOperationsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to platform operations status. It is expected to be a string value that signifies a specific status or message.

GetPlatformOperationsStatusResponse_200.title: Operations Status Response

maintenanceWindow.description: The scheduled maintenance window for the service.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the record (e.g., active, inactive).

updatedAt.description: The last updated timestamp for the operation.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the operation response.
